name: recon
description: Asset discovery and surface mapping. Enumerates subdomains, live hosts, ports, technologies, historical URLs, and crawled endpoints. Always runs first — all other playbooks depend on its output.

quick.description: Passive subdomain enum (subfinder only) + live host probe + nuclei critical/high. ~15 min.

standard.description: Full subdomain enum (subfinder + amass + assetfinder) + DNS resolution + live probe + historical URLs + katana crawl. ~45 min.

exhaustive.description: All standard steps + amass brute-force + dnsx brute + full gau + deep katana crawl + gowitness screenshots + port scanning. ~2-4 hours.

author: bb-beast
